# Textarea

## Description
Textarea takes free text that runs past one line, such as notes for the kitchen or a reason for cancelling, and grows with what is typed.

`import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"`, source `components/ui/textarea.tsx`, status `ready-with-gaps`.
Foundation: `shadcn textarea (base-nova, base)`. Traps checked: `trap/color-only-status` (States: invalid shows the caller's error text, not only a red border), `trap/reduced-motion-ignored` n/a because only `transition-colors` runs, `trap/motion-layout-property` (Motion: colours only), `trap/loading-layout-shift` n/a because Textarea has no loading state, `trap/decor-pointer` n/a because Textarea draws no decoration.

### Foundation
| Given by the foundation | Added by the team |
|---|---|
| shadcn base-nova `textarea`: a native `textarea` with `data-slot="textarea"`, `field-sizing-content min-h-16`, forwarding every `textarea` prop | The field classes are copied from Input (`rounded-lg`, `px-2.5`, `py-2`, `text-base md:text-sm`, focus, disabled, invalid and dark styles) so a form's fields match |

## Examples
Default: `docs/system/examples/textarea/default.tsx`.

Real uses, 0 call sites. The app draws 14 raw native textareas instead (`rg -n '<textarea' app components lib --glob '*.tsx'`), such as `app/(app)/kitchen/job-form-sections.tsx:168`, `app/(app)/engagement/enquiry-form.tsx:50` and `app/(app)/suppliers/supplier-form.tsx:160`. Each one rebuilds the field look from an input class plus its own height. Moving them onto Textarea is migration work, not part of this spec.

Example: A textarea with a visible label joined by htmlFor and a placeholder hint, the way kitchen notes read (`docs/system/examples/textarea/default.tsx`)

```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"

export default function TextareaDefault() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor="kitchen-notes">Notes for the kitchen</Label>
      <Textarea id="kitchen-notes" placeholder="Allergies, packaging, timing" maxLength={2000} />
    </div>
  )
}
```

Example: The Label joined by `htmlFor` above the field (`docs/system/examples/textarea/default.tsx`)

## Variants
Not applicable: Textarea has no variant props. Height grows with content from `min-h-16`.

## States
| State | Trigger | What the user can do | Shown by, besides color | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Empty | No value | Type | The placeholder, when the caller gives one | screenshot |
| Filled | A value | Edit the text | The text, and the field grows to fit it | screenshot |
| Focus visible | Focus | Type | A 3px ring round the field (`ring-3 ring-ring/50`) | screenshot |
| Invalid | `aria-invalid` from the caller | Fix the text | A red border and ring, and the caller's error text | screenshot |
| Disabled | `disabled` | Nothing, it ignores input | 50% opacity, a tinted fill and a not-allowed cursor | screenshot |

Example: Disabled and invalid textareas, the invalid one tied to its error line by aria-describedby (`docs/system/examples/textarea/states.tsx`)

```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"

export default function TextareaStates() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="ta-locked">Method or notes</Label>
        <Textarea id="ta-locked" disabled defaultValue="Soak the beans overnight, then boil for 40 minutes." />
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="ta-reason">Reason for cancelling</Label>
        <Textarea id="ta-reason" aria-invalid aria-describedby="ta-reason-error" required />
        <p id="ta-reason-error" className="text-xs text-destructive">Add a reason so the team knows why.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

Example: The same file, the "Reason for cancelling" field (`docs/system/examples/textarea/states.tsx`)

```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"

export default function TextareaStates() {
  return (

        <Textarea id="ta-locked" disabled defaultValue="Soak the beans overnight, then boil for 40 minutes." />
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="ta-reason">Reason for cancelling</Label>

        <p id="ta-reason-error" className="text-xs text-destructive">Add a reason so the team knows why.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

```

### State precedence
- Invalid and focus visible: both show. The ring is red.
- Disabled and filled: both show. The text stays readable at 50% opacity.
- Empty and filled: filled wins. The placeholder goes when text is typed.

### Motion
| Trigger | Kind | Preset | Properties | Reduced motion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Focus, blur or a change of invalid state | input | `transition-colors`, Tailwind's 150ms default, no named preset | background-color, border-color, color | Not handled, a 150ms colour fade only (NEEDS REVIEW) |

## Usage

### When to use
- Free text that may run past one line, such as notes, a reason, a description or a message.

### When not to use
- A single line of text, such as a name, or a date. Use DateField instead for a date, and the single-line `components/ui/input.tsx` field (not in the registry yet) for the rest.
- A fixed set of answers. Use Select instead.

### Rules
- Not applicable: Textarea has 0 call sites, so no rule has app evidence yet. The raw-textarea migration (G-04) brings the first ones.

### Content
- Not applicable: Textarea renders no text of its own. The label and placeholder are the caller's, in sentence case, such as "Notes for the kitchen".

### Anti-slop
- Not applicable: no rule has app evidence yet. The 14 raw native textareas are counted under Examples.

### Limits
- Not applicable: no length limit is built in. Callers pass `maxLength`, 500 or 2000 at today's raw call sites.

## Accessibility
Rests on a native `textarea`, which takes focus, reads its value and joins forms with no extra work. It has no visible name of its own, so the caller joins a Label with `id` and `htmlFor`, or passes `aria-label`, and ties error text with `aria-describedby`.

### Keyboard
| Key | Where focus is | Effect | Focus after | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tab | Before the textarea | Moves focus into it and draws the ring | The textarea | by hand |
| Enter | In the textarea | Adds a new line, never submits the form | The textarea | by hand |

### ARIA
| Part | Role | Accessible name from | States and properties | Announced | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Textarea | textbox (multi-line) | The joined Label, or `aria-label` | `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `required`, `disabled` | Name, role, value and the described error | by hand |

## Tokens
| Part | State | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Border | default | `border-input` (`--input`) |
| Placeholder | empty | `text-muted-foreground` (`--muted-foreground`) |
| Border and ring | focus visible | `border-ring`, `ring-ring/50` (`--ring`) |
| Border and ring | invalid | `border-destructive`, `ring-destructive/20` (`--destructive`) |
| Fill | disabled | `bg-input/50` (`--input` at 50%) |
| Radius | all | `rounded-lg` (`--radius-lg`) |
